_comment: Every place the weekly research pass must look. One entry per source; `instagram` is read in the built-in browser with scripts/ig-scan.browser.js (curl cannot read Instagram), `web` with curl and a browser User-Agent (scripts/research-sweep.mjs does all of them at once). A source is checked EVERY week unless `weekly` is false. scripts/research-check.mjs fails the draft when one was skipped. Add a venue the day it first turns up in someone else's post.

_rules.why: Andy, 2026-10-02: No. 16 ran nine Ijams Nature Center stories and one from Old Sevier on the weekend a music venue opened on Sevier Ave. Ijams Nature Center is a drive for most readers; Old Sevier is where they are.

sources.name: Old Sevier District (the merchants' association)
sources.note: THE HUB. Posts a First Friday game plan, a weekend roundup, a monthly can't-miss list, gameday and Halloween guides, each tagging every venue involved. Every dated item in a post from the last 10 days goes in the research log as a lead. The site's Google calendar (ics below) has been stale since May 2026; look anyway.

sources.name: The 808
sources.note: Music venue, opened 2026-10-02. The site's schedule reads cleanly with curl: date, act, doors, ages. Ticket prices on the site and in posts have disagreed; leave a price out unless both match.

sources.name: Alliance Brewing
sources.note: Site is hours only. The feed carries the events: Singer & Songwriter Night (Wed 7-10), free Casino Rueda salsa (Tue 7), The Breadlosers every 4th Sunday, one-off DJ nights, a gameday seltzer. Bands announce their own dates and tag the brewery.

sources.name: Hi-Wire Brewing Knoxville
sources.note: The profile is age-gated: a logged-out browser gets nothing (seen: 0). The events page has rendered empty since Sept 2026. Weekly lineup as of an April 2026 highlight, UNVERIFIED since: Mug Mondays, Flagship Tuesday, free trivia Wed 7 (Not Rocket Science), half-off drafts Thu, Sat yoga 11, Sunday Funday. Find Hi-Wire through the Old Sevier District's posts and through a signed-in Instagram session when there is one.

sources.name: Fly by Night
sources.note: Site is hours and menu. The feed carries closures for private parties, Survivor watch parties (Wed 8), karaoke Sundays, and DJ and band nights announced by the acts.

sources.name: Printshop Beer Co.
sources.note: Daily posts say who is pouring and what is on: First Friday shows, comedy open mic, D&D nights, yoga, food pop-ups, gallery calls. /specials/ has the weekly deals.

sources.name: Trailhead Beer Market
sources.note: The weekly lineup is a FLYER IMAGE; the caption only says 'planning their weekend?'. Read the scan's `img` text and open the post if it is thin. Kitchen is Gato Peligroso (@gatopeligrosokno).

sources.name: The Pink Cactus
sources.note: Posts a month-ahead list on the 1st, then one post per event: dance classes, DJ nights, comedy, fire shows, karaoke deals.

sources.name: SouthSide Garage
sources.note: /specials/ and /events/ are dated and reliable.

sources.name: Sevier Ave Burger Co.
sources.note: Burger and drink of the month on the 1st; Singo Wed 7; weekend brunch 11-2.

sources.name: South Coast Pizza
sources.note: Pizza of the month with Dia de Foods.

sources.name: Redbud Kitchen
sources.note: Hours and happy hour (weekdays 4-6) are on the site.

sources.name: Mighty Mud Studio
sources.note: A new gallery show opens every First Friday, 6-9; classes and one-night workshops on the site.

sources.name: SoKno Sourdough
sources.note: Bakery between Redbud and Hi-Wire. First Friday receptions 6-8; pop-ups announced by the guest.

sources.name: Borderland Tees and the Borderland Playhouse
sources.note: Live theater on Sevier Ave. Runs are produced by Knoxville Theatre Club.

sources.name: Knoxville Theatre Club
sources.note: Show dates, pick-your-price tickets.

sources.name: Old Sevier Market
sources.note: Grocery on Sevier Ave; grand opening Sat 2026-10-10.
